subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor RFC 27's experimental core `claws add` mutation and land this durable agent/workspace provenance slice after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but accepting a new core install lifecycle, CLI flags, config mutation path, and authoritative shared-state model is a product and ownership choice that review automation cannot make.

options.title: Sponsor and land the stack
options.body: Approve the core Claws direction, land the read-only base first, then refresh this PR on that base and require green exact-head gates.

options.title: Keep Claws read-only
options.body: Retain inspection and planning only, and close or rework this mutation slice until a different installation owner or lifecycle is approved.

options.title: Pause the RFC stack
options.body: Leave the implementation unmerged while maintainers resolve the broader Claw package, update, removal, and recovery ownership model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and land the stack
recommendation.body: Approve the core Claws direction, land the read-only base first, then refresh this PR on that base and require green exact-head gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR was explicitly routed to him and the unresolved choice is sponsorship of a new core product lifecycle rather than a mechanical code repair.
